The '''29th Producers Guild of America Awards''' (also known as '''2018 Producers Guild Awards'''), honoring the best [[Film producer|film]] and [[television producer]]s of 2017, were held at [[The Beverly Hilton]] in [[Beverly Hills, California]] on January 20, 2018.<ref>{{cite news|last1=Kilday|first1=Gregg|title=PGA Awards: 'The Shape of Water' Named Outstanding Motion Picture|url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/lists/producers-guild-awards-2018-winners-list-full-1074751|accessdate=January 21, 2018|work=The Hollywood Reporter|date=January 20, 2018}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|last1=Swertlow|first1=Meg|title=Producers Guild Awards 2018 Winners: The Complete List|url=http://www.eonline.com/news/907738/producers-guild-awards-2018-winners-the-complete-list|website=E! News|accessdate=January 21, 2018|date=January 20, 2018}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|title=PGA Awards: Producers Guild Sets Timeline For 2018 Show|url=https://deadline.com/2017/08/pga-awards-2018-timeline-nominations-honorees-1202143978/|accessdate=November 21, 2017|work=[[Deadline Hollywood|Deadline]]|date=August 7, 2017|language=en-US}}</ref>

The nominations for documentary film were announced on November 20, 2017.<ref>{{cite news|last1=Kilday|first1=Gregg|title=Producers Guild Unveils Documentary Feature Nominees
|url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/news/producers-guild-unveils-documentary-feature-nominees-1060581|accessdate=November 21, 2017|work=[[The Hollywood Reporter]]|date=November 20, 2017|language=en-US}}</ref> The nominations for film and television were announced on January 5, 2018.<ref>{{cite web|last1=Pedersen|first1=Erik|title=PGA Awards Film & TV Nominations Unveiled|url=https://deadline.com/2018/01/pga-awards-nominations-2018-1202236312/|website=[[Deadline Hollywood]]|access-date=January 5, 2018|date=January 5, 2018}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|last1=Dupre|first1=Elyse|title=2018 Producers Guild Award Nominations: The Full List of Film and TV Nominees|url=http://www.eonline.com/ca/news/903983/2018-producers-guild-award-nominations-the-full-list-of-film-and-tv-nominees|website=E! News|accessdate=January 5, 2018|date=January 5, 2018}}</ref>
